name: arena-virtual-office
description: Arena Virtual Company — a top-down 2D office where your existing Arena AI agents work as employees.

scripts.preview:render: npx esbuild src/engine/layout.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/layout.mjs --log-level=error && npx esbuild scripts/preview.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/preview.mjs --log-level=error --platform=node && node scripts/render-preview.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/assert-clean.mjs && npm run test:layout && npm run test:integration && npm run test:ui && npm run test:render
